skill.name: artifacts-builder
skill.description: Suite of tools for creating elaborate, multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend web technologies (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui). Use for complex artifacts requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui components - not for simple single-file HTML/JSX artifacts.
skill.summary: Scaffold and bundle complex React applications as self-contained HTML artifacts.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Bash syntax, Markdown formatting, fixed project configuration writes, and documentation links. The scripts still execute unpinned packages, may install pnpm globally, and extract bundled source that was outside the text scan. Publication should require clearer consent and stronger dependency and archive controls.

remediation.issue: The scripts download and execute unpinned packages, and setup may install pnpm globally.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact package versions, provide a lockfile, avoid global installation, and request confirmation before downloads or lifecycle scripts run.

remediation.issue: The setup extracts source from an archive that was not included in the four-file text scan.
remediation.suggestion: Publish extracted sources, scan every payload file, verify the archive checksum, and reject absolute or parent-directory paths before extraction.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Dependency Installation
semantic_findings.description: The setup and bundle scripts download and execute unpinned packages, and setup may install pnpm globally. Registry compromise or upstream drift could execute unexpected lifecycle code.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The scripts explicitly use latest create-vite, global npm installation, and several package installs without a lockfile. Those commands can execute downloaded package lifecycle scripts.

semantic_findings.title: Bundled Archive Outside Static Scan
semantic_findings.description: The setup script extracts a bundled component archive into generated source, but the audit reports only four scanned text files. Unreviewed archive content could introduce code without source-level analysis.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The extraction command is explicit, and the archive payload is not represented among the four scanned files. Its manifest uses relative paths, which reduces path traversal risk but not the code-review gap.

content.value_statement: Complex interactive artifacts require more structure than a single HTML file. This skill scaffolds React projects and bundles them into self-contained HTML artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Creates a React 18 and TypeScript project with Vite.
Configures Tailwind CSS 3.4.1, shadcn/ui theming, and path aliases.
Installs Radix UI dependencies and extracts more than 40 interface components.
Adds Parcel configuration for TypeScript path resolution and asset bundling.
Builds the project and inlines JavaScript, CSS, and assets into bundle.html.
limitations: Requires Bash, Node.js 18 or newer, and package registry access.
May install pnpm globally when pnpm is unavailable.
Targets complex React artifacts rather than simple single-file HTML or JSX.
Does not automatically test the completed artifact.

best_practices: Review dependency installation before running either script.
Use this skill when state, routing, or reusable components justify a full React project.
Test bundle.html across target viewport sizes before sharing it.
anti_patterns: Do not use the full scaffold for a simple static document.
Do not run the bundling script in a project with uncommitted output files named dist or bundle.html.
Do not assume successful bundling confirms accessibility or interaction quality.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a React and TypeScript project configured for Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and single-file HTML bundling.

faq.question: What software is required?
faq.answer: You need Bash, Node.js 18 or newer, and network access to a package registry.

faq.question: Does it produce one shareable file?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundling script builds the project and creates bundle.html with application assets inlined.

faq.question: Is it suitable for simple HTML pages?
faq.answer: It can build them, but its setup is intended for complex artifacts with state, routing, or component libraries.

faq.question: Are shadcn/ui components included?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup extracts more than 40 components and installs their Radix UI dependencies.

faq.question: Does the skill test the artifact?
faq.answer: No. Testing is optional and requires available browser tools such as Playwright or Puppeteer.
